incident_location: Northgate Public Library, Central branch front desk
summary: Checkout of Salt and Cedar for the base term on a research card
story: Sana Iqbal asks for Salt and Cedar for a new reading list. The catalog holds three copies, and none is on loan, so a copy is free. Her card is a research membership in good standing, she holds one loan, and no title on her card is overdue. She asks for the usual term.

incident_location: Northgate Public Library, Central branch front desk
summary: Checkout of The Lighthouse Keeper while the borrower holds three loans
story: June Alvarez asks for The Lighthouse Keeper. The catalog holds four copies, and two are on loan, so a copy is free. Her card is a standard membership in good standing, but she holds three loans today, which is the most a borrower may hold.
